amendments.note: initial freeze before Phase 4 data collection

fe:0009: drop bare 'Kadappa'/'கடப்பா' surface form — collides with the Andhra place name Kadapa/Cuddapah, causing false-positive corpus-leak hits (historical geography + 'Kadappa Black' limestone). The dish stays held out via 'Kumbakonam Kadappa' / 'kadappa kurma'.

2026-09-21: swapped fe:0001/0003/0009 (leaked into the grown domain corpus - well-documented real dishes inevitably appear in a broad South Indian recipe corpus) for verified-clean obscure replacements; dropped fe:0010's overly-generic 'Tapioca Root' surface form (leaked into 4 FineWeb-Edu shards). Found via scan_leakage.py run before the 150M training launch.

2026-09-21 (follow-up): fully retired fe:0010 (Maravalli Kizhangu/tapioca) rather than continuing to patch surface-form spellings -- even after dropping 'Tapioca Root', the native-language form 'maravalli kilangu' itself leaked once into FineWeb-Edu (shard_00069). Replaced with Putnala (roasted gram), verified clean everywhere. Found by a second scan_leakage.py rerun after the first amendment.
